Name: Bachelors portrait overhaul 1.3
Author: bluestarkiller
Description:
[b][size=6]***This is not a copy/paste replacement but a mod and will need to go in the StardewValley/Mods folder.
[/size][/b][b][size=6]You will need Content Patcher by Pathoschild for it to run. Download it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]here[/url]***[/size]
[/b]
[b]1.3 Update:[/b][b] [/b]Fixed the coding error caused by Content Patcher 2.0

[b]1.2 Update:[/b] Merged all files to a single zip. just delete the ones you don't want. Fixed an error in the content.json files and did some playtesting, they all work now.
[size=3]
This mod will replace all the bachelors' portraits in the game.
It is intended to make them appear roughly the same age (somewhere in their 20s) so younger guys like Sam, Sebastian and Alex will appear as older while Shane and Harvey will seem younger than the vanilla ones.
[/size]
[size=3]If you should have any issues with this mod please let me know. Also if there are any suggestions for new outfits let me know and I'll see about them.[/size]

[b]WIP:[/b][size=3] Sprite sheets to match the portraits.[/size]


[size=6]How to install:[/size]

﻿ ﻿1. Install Content Patcher using this link [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]here[/url]﻿.
﻿ ﻿2. Download the file
﻿ ﻿3. Extract the zip files and paste the folder for the characters you want to change into your Mods folder.
﻿ ﻿4. Run the game once so a config.json file is created in the folder for each mod.
﻿ ﻿5. Select which options you want in the config.json file for that character, I've included the options available for each character.


[size=3]After you install this mod and run the game once a config.json folder will be created. You will be able to select between a number of options for each character mod:

On winter he won't appear shirtless no matter which option you chose, he will wear the winter coat you selected on option 4.
